Select distinct molecule identifiers, names, and canonical SMILES for compounds in document CHEMBL4651402. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, and to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by doc_chembl_id. Require canonical_smiles to be present. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
